evidence.quote: Yeah, like I said, I want to return it. I found a better deal. So, I want to cancel it.
Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?

observed_facts: The agent correctly identified the pending laptop order #W2417020 and informed the user that cancellation requires choosing either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.
The user refused to select one of the two permitted cancellation reasons and demanded a transfer to a human agent.
The agent transferred the user to a human agent as requested when the user refused to provide the required policy-compliant cancellation reason.
inference: The simulated user's refusal to cooperate with the required domain policy options ('no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') and insistence on escalating caused the task to fail.
The agent followed all rules regarding order status checks, cancellation reasons, and escalation.
needs_verification: Whether the user's intent should have been interpreted as implicitly satisfying 'no longer needed'.
parsed.summary: The task failed because the user refused to select one of the policy-required cancellation reasons ('no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') and insisted on transferring to a human agent.
